The Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p2-79-5D6_RA_7_Fivedesix.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-5d6ra7-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-p2-79-5D6_RA_7_Fivedesix-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), Dark Side p. 2: “[Pilot] 2. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate 1 Force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your Reserve Deck; 0 or 7, you may retrieve 1 Force.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 3). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “draws a destiny” for “draws destiny” and “activate one force” for “activate 1 Force”, and drops the comma after “0 or 7” (it also writes the pilot icon out as “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots” and uses lower case for “scomp”, “reserve deck” and “force”): “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a scomp link when opponent draws a destiny of: 1-3, you may activate one force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your reserve deck; 0 or 7 you may retrieve 1 force.”.<ref name="cl-1273_1-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
